expectation: I will ask four short questions, show the complete recommendation, and wait for your approval before adding anything. You can choose one or several numbers, or write your own answer.
footer: Choose one or several numbers, or write your own answer.
normalizing: Thank you. I am matching your own wording to the research capabilities now.
confirmation_retry: Please answer yes to approve the complete recommendation, or no to stop without installing anything.
installing: Thank you. I am installing the approved research capabilities and will verify them before saying the workspace is ready.
declined: Nothing was installed. You can restart setup whenever you want.
installation_failed: Setup could not be completed safely. Nothing will be described as ready until the installed state is verified.
completion: Evidence Lab is ready. Open a new task so the application can load the new research capabilities. Start that task with what you actually want to work on; you will not need to repeat setup.
